name: code-story
description: Turn a branch, a pull request or a stack of them into a code story: a chaptered page that teaches how and why the change works, re-cut into the steps it could have been reviewed in, with notes pinned to the lines they explain, built-in dark diagrams, English plus an optional second language, and updates published under the same link.

second_language.title: Second language
second_language.description: Language tag of a second story language beside English, such as pl or de. Code identifiers and programming terms stay in English. Leave empty for English only.

gloss_first_use.title: Gloss terms on first use
gloss_first_use.description: In the second language, follow an English term's first use with its translation in parentheses

diagram_skill.title: Diagram skill
diagram_skill.description: Name of an installed skill that draws the story's diagrams, such as fireworks-tech-graph. Leave empty for the built-in diagrams.

uncommitted.title: Uncommitted changes
uncommitted.description: ignore: tell the committed change without asking; include: add uncommitted changes without asking; ask: ask each time there are any

stack.title: Pull request stack
stack.description: When the branch sits in a stack of open pull requests: ask whether to tell the whole stack, always tell it, or never
